status: Proposed shared dimensional contract; engineering test only; no final form or runtime acceptance
axes: X east, Y up, Z south; module forward is local -Z; positive yaw turns the forward axis east

flight.pivot: bottom centre at the first riser, floor datum
flight.reject_if: Step >0.20 m, clear width <2.4 m, tread mismatch or port gap >0.001 m

landing.reject_if: Flight socket is separated or a guard crosses either arrival

opening.destination: Upper test platform, with a reverse route through the same open passage
opening.construction: Extruded closed wall profile surrounding a real through-aperture; no decorative model, solid wall infill or final Blender export
opening.reject_if: Opening blocked, aperture <2.4 m clear, headroom <2.05 m or floor discontinuity

parapet.support: Deck edge or stair stringer; substrate collider stays opaque to navigation when decorative/glass variants change
parapet.reject_if: Collider gap, unprotected drop or a barrier crossing a module socket
parapet.end_infill_policy: Keep each full repeat at exactly 1 m; use an explicit short end-infill host for the remainder. Never scale a decorated repeat to fit.

rendering.palette_mode: simple rose/ivory/gold and glass-slot preview; no marble or carving fidelity claimed
rendering.final_lods: unresolved; benchmark accepted models before choosing distance bands

sources.use: existing stepped flight and structural/decor separation
variant vocabulary; not a source for measured risers
existing slopes, returns, end stops and rail profiles
existing material/shape variants; 0.45 m garden edging is not treated as a drop guard

scope_limits: No new art sheets or paid mesh generation
No changes to geography, castle silhouette, bedroom, cottage placements or reference registry
No final room assembly, GLB export, game integration or deployment
User review still required for final kit shape and any paid/final asset work
